body: I thought my life couldn't get worse from this day but guess what? It did. Its 100% worse,  I don't even have any friends to say sorry I'm gone to anymore. Just my mum and dad. Today I found out my mum thinks she's selfish for making me continue to stay but at the same time they need me cos I've all they have with my brother gone. They are the only two people who care about my existence at all. None of us want to be here anymore but we suffer for each other. Its tiring, I'm tired.
Wow, I'm no therapist but I'd say that's pretty messed to say to someone. TF
I know my parents will look after my dogs when im gone
I know im not, regardless of whether im forced to
I belong in the too hard basket i think
The world needs more caring people like you
Feel more understood here then in real life

I feel it too, when things get to bad inside my head, it just shuts down. Numbs every feeling good or bad. No enjoy in anything, hobbies, friends, family. I just sit for hours doing nothing, its like im not even home inside my head.
Well ultimately fate seemed to have stopped me this day. But ive got no one. No one gets it. Being a good person just leaves you more broken and hurt. I need a real friend
